<infobox theme="Media">
    <image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label></data>	
        <data source="runtime"><label>Run time</label></data>
        <data source="upc"><label>[[Wikipedia:Universal Product Code|UPC]]</label></data>
        <data source="isbn"><label>[[Wikipedia:International Standard Book Number|ISBN]]</label><format>[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn}}}|{{{isbn}}}]]</format></data>
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Technical information</header>
        <data source="media type"><label>Media type</label></data>	
        <data source="resolution"><label>Video resolution(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="ratio"><label>Aspect ratio(s)</label></data>
        <data source="audio"><label>Audio</label></data>
        <data source="subtitles"><label>Subtitle(s)</label></data>	
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:HomeVideo|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
